about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Sunday within the Octave of the Nativity of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Through the working of this mystery, O Lord, may our vices be cleansed and our just desires fulfilled. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: O Lord, the working of this mystery
who lives and reigns with You
